intent_summary: Detect declared related-metric changes within unfinished periods while separating finalized subperiod evidence, completed daily aggregates, and partial progress.

criteria.criterion: Callers select related datasets with identical native boundaries, entity scope, declared aggregation semantics, and compatible period definitions.
criteria.notes: Native comparisons enforce matching cadence, timestamps and entities, but daily aggregation bypasses native compatibility: an hourly/two-hourly pair produces daily ratios despite native alignment failure.

criteria.criterion: Finalized subperiod relationships retain each source value and original source index; unavailable or incomplete sources yield explicit unavailability.
Completed aggregate ratios use aggregated numerators and denominators; a ratio of totals is not silently replaced by an average of individual ratios.
Open-period progress remains separate from completed-period evidence and identifies coverage; correlated resolutions do not count as independent corroboration.
